title: Eric DeCosta: "Unfortunate" we didn't draft a center, but wouldn't have done things differently

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eric DeCosta: "Unfortunate" we didn't draft a center, but wouldn't have done things differently
sources.description: The Ravens drafted an offensive lineman in the first round and added another one later in the draft, but neither of those players provided them with an option to replace the departed Tyler Linderbaum at center.
